title: chitonia mirabilis
intro: Chitonia mirabilis, commonly known as "Mirabilis jalapa", is a flowering plant in the four o'clock family (Nyctaginaceae). It is known for its vibrant flowers that change color depending on the temperature, typically exhibiting white flowers in the evening and pink or red flowers in the morning. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis jalapa include its ability to reduce inflammation, treat ulcers, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
